footer_tagline: Built for outdoor athletes. Made with ❤️ for the trails.
home_meta_title: GritShot — Turn Your Adventures Into Art
home_meta_description: Transform your Garmin activities and trail photos into stunning shareable GritShots with embedded statistics.
home_hero_subtitle: Upload your Garmin FIT file, add your trail photo, and create a stunning shareable GritShot with embedded stats — distance, elevation, time and more.
home_example_caption: Your photo + Garmin stats, ready to share
home_how_it_works_heading: Three steps to a shareable GritShot
home_step_1_text: Export your activity from Garmin Connect and upload the FIT file. Distance, elevation, pace, heart rate — all parsed automatically.
home_step_2_text: Upload the best shot from your run, hike, or ride. GritShot overlays the stats right onto your image.
home_step_3_text: Download your custom GritShot and share it on WhatsApp, Instagram, or wherever you celebrate your outdoor adventures.
home_feature_privacy_text: Your photos and FIT files are processed on the server but never stored — nothing is saved, no tracking, no selling.
home_feature_fit_text: Upload your Garmin FIT file directly — no account connection needed.
home_feature_stats_text: Distance, elevation, pace, time, heart rate and more — pick what to show.
home_feature_photo_text: Overlay your statistics onto your own trail photos for a personal touch.
home_feature_social_text: Export in formats optimized for Instagram, Strava, and other platforms.
home_feature_activities_text: Works with all Garmin outdoor activity types — trail running, cycling, hiking.
home_cta_heading: Ready to show off your next adventure?
home_cta_subtitle: Upload your FIT file, add a photo, and create your first GritShot in minutes.
create_subtitle: Upload your Garmin FIT file and a trail photo to generate your shareable GritShot.
